Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the target CHEMBL3553 (TYK2) in assays where the organism is Homo sapiens. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL3553 and assay_organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return the columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
